title: 隧道耐震接頭設計
summary: 本課聚焦以相對位移、接頭剛度與止水餘量理解隧道耐震接頭。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。
summaryEn: This course focuses on understand seismic tunnel joints through relative movement, joint stiffness and sealing reserve. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波傳軸向應變」與「接頭相對伸長」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wave induced axial strain" and "Joint relative extension": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波傳軸向應變：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wave induced axial strain: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「波傳軸向應變」如何影響隧道耐震接頭設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wave induced axial strain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic tunnel-joint design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地下結構受地震波強迫變形，和地面建物單看慣性力的模型不同。沿隧道方向的簡化平面波可用粒子速度與對應波速估應變，但必須指定方向及波型。假設沿隧道方向的適用平面波粒子速度v=0.50m/s、對應波速c=500m/s，ε=v/c=0.001；不能代入任意方向的總峰值。若將剪波速度搭配無關方向的粒子速度，應變需求可被誤估；硬軟地層交界又可集中相對位移，平均波傳模型可能漏掉真正控制的接頭。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波傳軸向應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seismic waves impose ground deformation on tunnels, unlike a model considering only building inertia. A simplified wave along the tunnel relates particle velocity to the corresponding wave speed, requiring an explicit direction and wave type. For an appropriate plane wave along the tunnel, particle velocity v=0.50m/s and corresponding c=500m/s give ε=0.001. An arbitrary total peak is unsuitable. Combining shear-wave speed with unrelated particle motion misestimates strain. Stiff-soft transitions can also concentrate displacement, so a mean wave model may miss the joint controlling actual performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wave induced axial strain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿隧道方向的適用平面波粒子速度v=0.50m/s、對應波速c=500m/s，ε=v/c=0.001；不能代入任意方向的總峰值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an appropriate plane wave along the tunnel, particle velocity v=0.50m/s and corresponding c=500m/s give ε=0.001.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要波傳軸向應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for wave induced axial strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「波傳軸向應變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wave induced axial strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 波傳軸向應變
knowledge.text: 地下結構受地震波強迫變形，和地面建物單看慣性力的模型不同。沿隧道方向的簡化平面波可用粒子速度與對應波速估應變，但必須指定方向及波型。
knowledge.textEn: Seismic waves impose ground deformation on tunnels, unlike a model considering only building inertia. A simplified wave along the tunnel relates particle velocity to the corresponding wave speed, requiring an explicit direction and wave type.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要波傳軸向應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for wave induced axial strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「隧道耐震接頭設計」的「波傳軸向應變：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「地下水與沉陷觀測室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Wave induced axial strain: mechanism and system paths” in “Seismic tunnel-joint design”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Groundwater and settlement observatory” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「波傳軸向應變」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wave induced axial strain" is correct?
options: 只要波傳軸向應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
地下結構受地震波強迫變形，和地面建物單看慣性力的模型不同。
只要接頭相對伸長符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: A nominal result for wave induced axial strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Seismic waves impose ground deformation on tunnels, unlike a model considering only building inertia.
A nominal result for joint relative extension removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 地下結構受地震波強迫變形，和地面建物單看慣性力的模型不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Seismic waves impose ground deformation on tunnels, unlike a model considering only building inertia. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 波傳軸向應變：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wave induced axial strain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「波傳軸向應變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wave induced axial strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿隧道方向的適用平面波粒子速度v=0.50m/s、對應波速c=500m/s，ε=v/c=0.001；不能代入任意方向的總峰值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an appropriate plane wave along the tunnel, particle velocity v=0.50m/s and corresponding c=500m/s give ε=0.001. An arbitrary total peak is unsuitable. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對地震輸入的方向、波型與波速剖面，將自由場應變和土結互制分析比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check input direction, wave type and velocity profile, comparing free-field strain with interaction analysis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿隧道方向的適用平面波粒子速度v=0.50m/s、對應波速c=500m/s，ε=v/c=0.001；不能代入任意方向的總峰值。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an appropriate plane wave along the tunnel, particle velocity v=0.50m/s and corresponding c=500m/s give ε=0.001. An arbitrary total peak is unsuitable.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「波傳軸向應變」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wave induced axial strain", which statement holds?
options: 只要轉角邊緣張開符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要連接件局部應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿隧道方向的適用平面波粒子速度v=0.50m/s、對應波速c=500m/s，ε=v/c=0.001；不能代入任意方向的總峰值。
optionsEn: A nominal result for rotation induced edge opening removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for local connector strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an appropriate plane wave along the tunnel, particle velocity v=0.50m/s and corresponding c=500m/s give ε=0.001.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設沿隧道方向的適用平面波粒子速度v=0.50m/s、對應波速c=500m/s，ε=v/c=0.001；不能代入任意方向的總峰值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an appropriate plane wave along the tunnel, particle velocity v=0.50m/s and corresponding c=500m/s give ε=0.001. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 波傳軸向應變：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wave induced axial strain: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「波傳軸向應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wave induced axial strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對地震輸入的方向、波型與波速剖面，將自由場應變和土結互制分析比較。對斜交波及地層變化保留專門分析，不把此式當所有地震情境的包絡值。同時排除以下干擾原因：若將剪波速度搭配無關方向的粒子速度，應變需求可被誤估；硬軟地層交界又可集中相對位移，平均波傳模型可能漏掉真正控制的接頭。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check input direction, wave type and velocity profile, comparing free-field strain with interaction analysis. Oblique waves and stratigraphic transitions require specific treatment; the relation is not a universal seismic envelope. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Combining shear-wave speed with unrelated particle motion misestimates strain. Stiff-soft transitions can also concentrate displacement, so a mean wave model may miss the joint controlling actual performance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接波傳軸向應變時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對地震輸入的方向、波型與波速剖面，將自由場應變和土結互制分析比較。對斜交波及地層變化保留專門分析，不把此式當所有地震情境的包絡值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over wave induced axial strain, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Check input direction, wave type and velocity profile, comparing free-field strain with interaction analysis. Oblique waves and stratigraphic transitions require specific treatment; the relation is not a universal seismic envelope.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若將剪波速度搭配無關方向的粒子速度，應變需求可被誤估；硬軟地層交界又可集中相對位移，平均波傳模型可能漏掉真正控制的接頭。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Combining shear-wave speed with unrelated particle motion misestimates strain. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 核對地震輸入的方向、波型與波速剖面，將自由場應變和土結互制分析比較。對斜交波及地層變化保留專門分析，不把此式當所有地震情境的包絡值。同時排除以下干擾原因：若將剪波速度搭配無關方向的粒子速度，應變需求可被誤估；硬軟地層交界又可集中相對位移，平均波傳模型可能漏掉真正控制的接頭。
knowledge.textEn: Check input direction, wave type and velocity profile, comparing free-field strain with interaction analysis. Oblique waves and stratigraphic transitions require specific treatment; the relation is not a universal seismic envelope. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Combining shear-wave speed with unrelated particle motion misestimates strain. Stiff-soft transitions can also concentrate displacement, so a mean wave model may miss the joint controlling actual performance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接波傳軸向應變時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對地震輸入的方向、波型與波速剖面，將自由場應變和土結互制分析比較。對斜交波及地層變化保留專門分析，不把此式當所有地震情境的包絡值。

Check input direction, wave type and velocity profile, comparing free-field strain with interaction analysis. quiz.question: 要驗證「波傳軸向應變」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wave induced axial strain"?
options: 核對地震輸入的方向、波型與波速剖面，將自由場應變和土結互制分析比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要串聯柔度分配符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Check input direction, wave type and velocity profile, comparing free-field strain with interaction analysis.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A nominal result for series compliance sharing removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 核對地震輸入的方向、波型與波速剖面，將自由場應變和土結互制分析比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check input direction, wave type and velocity profile, comparing free-field strain with interaction analysis. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 波傳軸向應變：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wave induced axial strain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「波傳軸向應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wave induced axial strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若將剪波速度搭配無關方向的粒子速度，應變需求可被誤估；硬軟地層交界又可集中相對位移，平均波傳模型可能漏掉真正控制的接頭。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Combining shear-wave speed with unrelated particle motion misestimates strain. Stiff-soft transitions can also concentrate displacement, so a mean wave model may miss the joint controlling actual performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若將剪波速度搭配無關方向的粒子速度，應變需求可被誤估；硬軟地層交界又可集中相對位移，平均波傳模型可能漏掉真正控制的接頭。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Stiff-soft transitions can also concentrate displacement, so a mean wave model may miss the joint controlling actual performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要波傳軸向應變符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nominal result for wave induced axial strain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若將剪波速度搭配無關方向的粒子速度，應變需求可被誤估；硬軟地層交界又可集中相對位移，平均波傳模型可能漏掉真正控制的接頭。
knowledge.textEn: Combining shear-wave speed with unrelated particle motion misestimates strain. Stiff-soft transitions can also concentrate displacement, so a mean wave model may miss the joint controlling actual performance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「波傳軸向應變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wave induced axial strain" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若將剪波速度搭配無關方向的粒子速度，應變需求可被誤估；硬軟地層交界又可集中相對位移，平均波傳模型可能漏掉真正控制的接頭。
只要接頭相對伸長符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Combining shear-wave speed with unrelated particle motion misestimates strain.
A nominal result for joint relative extension removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
quiz.explanation: 若將剪波速度搭配無關方向的粒子速度，應變需求可被誤估；硬軟地層交界又可集中相對位移，平均波傳模型可能漏掉真正控制的接頭。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Combining shear-wave speed with unrelated particle motion misestimates strain. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 接頭相對伸長：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint relative extension: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接頭相對伸長」如何影響隧道耐震接頭設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint relative extension” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic tunnel-joint design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 軸向地盤應變在一段長度上累積成位移，但並非全部都集中在單一接頭。襯砌軸向剛度、地盤摩擦及接頭分布共同決定分配，簡式只是指定分攤情境。假設ε=0.001均勻作用於L=20m且這段變形分配給所查接頭，Δ=εL=0.020m即20mm；實際分配另算。若把全長地盤位移同時分配到每一接頭，會重複計算需求；若反過來平均分攤而忽略一處特別柔軟，則可能低估該處張開與止水破壞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接頭相對伸長」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Axial ground strain accumulates over length but does not necessarily concentrate at one joint. Lining stiffness, ground friction and joint distribution govern sharing; the simple relation represents a specified allocation scenario. If ε=0.001 acts uniformly over L=20m and that segment's deformation is allocated to the checked joint, Δ=0.020m, or20mm; real sharing needs analysis. Allocating total tunnel displacement to every joint double counts demand. Uniform sharing can instead understate opening at an unusually flexible joint and miss loss of water sealing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint relative extension” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設ε=0.001均勻作用於L=20m且這段變形分配給所查接頭，Δ=εL=0.020m即20mm；實際分配另算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If ε=0.001 acts uniformly over L=20m and that segment's deformation is allocated to the checked joint, Δ=0.020m, or20mm; real sharing needs analysis.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要接頭相對伸長符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nominal result for joint relative extension removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接頭相對伸長」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint relative extension”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A nominal result for joint relative extension removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接頭相對伸長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

只要接頭剪切剛度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
軸向地盤應變在一段長度上累積成位移，但並非全部都集中在單一接頭。
optionsEn: A nominal result for joint relative extension removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for joint shear stiffness removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
Axial ground strain accumulates over length but does not necessarily concentrate at one joint.

steps.title: 接頭相對伸長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint relative extension: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接頭相對伸長」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint relative extension” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非現場設定值：假設ε=0.001均勻作用於L=20m且這段變形分配給所查接頭，Δ=εL=0.020m即20mm；實際分配另算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If ε=0.001 acts uniformly over L=20m and that segment's deformation is allocated to the checked joint, Δ=0.020m, or20mm; real sharing needs analysis. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將環縫與縱向接頭位置畫成變形相容圖，檢查位移和襯砌伸長的總和。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map circumferential and longitudinal joints in a compatibility diagram, checking the sum of joint movement and lining extension.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設ε=0.001均勻作用於L=20m且這段變形分配給所查接頭，Δ=εL=0.020m即20mm；實際分配另算。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If ε=0.001 acts uniformly over L=20m and that segment's deformation is allocated to the checked joint, Δ=0.020m, or20mm; real sharing needs analysis.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接頭相對伸長」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設ε=0.001均勻作用於L=20m且這段變形分配給所查接頭，Δ=εL=0.020m即20mm；實際分配另算。
只要止水壓縮幾何餘量符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。
只要斷層變形帶需求符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。

A nominal result for seal compression geometry reserve removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
A nominal result for fault deformation band demand removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not field settings: If ε=0.001 acts uniformly over L=20m and that segment's deformation is allocated to the checked joint, Δ=0.020m, or20mm; real sharing needs analysis. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 接頭相對伸長：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Joint relative extension: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「接頭相對伸長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint relative extension” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將環縫與縱向接頭位置畫成變形相容圖，檢查位移和襯砌伸長的總和。比較接頭量測及模型結果，對端部、剛度變化與特殊構造另設控制點。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把全長地盤位移同時分配到每一接頭，會重複計算需求；若反過來平均分攤而忽略一處特別柔軟，則可能低估該處張開與止水破壞。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map circumferential and longitudinal joints in a compatibility diagram, checking the sum of joint movement and lining extension. Compare measured and modelled response at ends, stiffness changes and special structures. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Allocating total tunnel displacement to every joint double counts demand. Uniform sharing can instead understate opening at an unusually flexible joint and miss loss of water sealing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接接頭相對伸長時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。將環縫與縱向接頭位置畫成變形相容圖，檢查位移和襯砌伸長的總和。比較接頭量測及模型結果，對端部、剛度變化與特殊構造另設控制點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: When handing over joint relative extension, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Map circumferential and longitudinal joints in a compatibility diagram, checking the sum of joint movement and lining extension. Compare measured and modelled response at ends, stiffness changes and special structures.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把全長地盤位移同時分配到每一接頭，會重複計算需求；若反過來平均分攤而忽略一處特別柔軟，則可能低估該處張開與止水破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Allocating total tunnel displacement to every joint double counts demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Compare measured and modelled response at ends, stiffness changes and special structures. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Allocating total tunnel displacement to every joint double counts demand. Uniform sharing can instead understate opening at an unusually flexible joint and miss loss of water sealing.

steps.instruction: 若把全長地盤位移同時分配到每一接頭，會重複計算需求；若反過來平均分攤而忽略一處特別柔軟，則可能低估該處張開與止水破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Allocating total tunnel displacement to every joint double counts demand.
